title: fix(create-objectstack): the scaffolded AGENTS.md lists only the src directories the config loads
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XL51wryBuAmngcxc4MhBYSV)_

Fixes #28954

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：脚手架生成的 `AGENTS.md` 里「Project Structure」目录树，现在只列 `objectstack.config.ts` 真正加载的 8 个目录（objects、views、actions、flows、dashboards、apps、skills、picklists），去掉了从不加载的 `reports/`、`agents/`、`i18n/`、`handlers/`，并加一句：新目录必须在 config 里接线，否则既不加载也不被 validate 检查。另加一条包内测试，把这棵目录树和模板 config 的 barrel 导入对齐。
- **为什么改**：按「Build with Claude Code」路径的新手，coding agent 先读 AGENTS.md，再照着目录树写元数据；写进那四个死目录的东西不会加载，`npm run validate` 还照样通过，用户以为是 AI 写坏了。
- **风险与回滚**：极低。只改模板里的说明文字和一条测试，config 加载什么完全不变；已生成的项目不受影响。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/AGENTS.md`（Project Structure 一节）；`packages/create-objectstack/src/agents-project-structure.test.ts`（新增的对齐测试）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter create-objectstack exec vitest run src/agents-project-structure.test.ts`，预期 3/3 通过（main 上 2 条红：多出 agents/handlers/i18n/reports，缺 picklists/skills）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## Why

A newcomer on the "Build with Claude Code" path has a coding agent read `AGENTS.md` before it writes any metadata. The block told the agent to put reports in `src/reports/`, AI agents in `src/agents/`, translations in `src/i18n/` and hooks in `src/handlers/`. The scaffolded `objectstack.config.ts` imports none of those, so what the agent wrote there was never loaded, and `npm run validate` neither counted nor checked it (the card's repro: an invalid report there, `✓ Validation passed`).

## What changes

- **`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/AGENTS.md`, the Project Structure block.** The `src/` tree now lists exactly the eight directories the config wires, in the config's order: `objects/`, `views/`, `actions/`, `flows/`, `dashboards/`, `apps/`, `skills/`, `picklists/`. `reports/`, `agents/`, `i18n/` and `handlers/` are gone. Below the tree, one paragraph: these are exactly the directories `objectstack.config.ts` wires, and a new `src/` directory is never loaded, and `npm run validate` neither counts nor checks what it holds, until its `index.ts` barrel is imported in `objectstack.config.ts` and handed to its stack key there (the config's own comment says the same).
- **New `packages/create-objectstack/src/agents-project-structure.test.ts`.** For every bundled template in `TEMPLATES` that has an `objectstack.config.ts`, the block's `src/` directories equal the config's `import * as X from './src/X'` barrels, as sets, both ways. A third case pins that the section names `objectstack.config.ts` and says "never loaded". A package test, not a gate script.
- **What any config loads is unchanged.** No template file other than `AGENTS.md` is touched.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/scaffold-agents-md-wired-dirs.md`: `patch` on `create-objectstack` (the templates ship inside its `dist`), with both declaration lines and the one-line adoption note for an existing project.

**Step 1 measurement (the order's ruling 2).** `TEMPLATES` (`src/template-registry.ts`) has one bundled template, `blank`. All templates share one `AGENTS.md` (`src/templates/AGENTS.md`, rendered by `index.ts` into every project); no template carries its own. `blank/objectstack.config.ts` imports eight barrels: objects, views, actions, flows, dashboards, apps, skills, picklists. The old block named ten `src/` directories: six of those eight, plus `reports/`, `agents/`, `i18n/`, `handlers/`; `skills/` and `picklists/` were missing. `blank/README.md` (its Layout section) already names exactly the eight, so it is unchanged.

## Tests

- **Red on base `ee7518f9`** (`AGENTS.md` checked out from base, the new test kept): 2 failed, 1 passed. The set case received `agents`, `handlers`, `i18n`, `reports` and lacked `picklists`, `skills`; the wiring-sentence case failed. Restored: `git status --porcelain` empty, blob `8f0801f4fac0` equal to HEAD.
- **Green on head:** 3/3.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-off, from committed HEAD)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` inserted `│   ├── reports/              # ABLATED-28954 Analytics reports` back into the tree (anchor `# BI dashboards` + newline + the `apps/` line, 1 → 0; blob `8f0801f4fac0` → `fad5dd511c4f`; the marker counted once on disk). The test: 1 failed, 2 passed, the set case receiving `+ "reports"`. The tool restored the file and proved it: blob equal to HEAD `8f0801f4fac0`, `git diff HEAD` empty; `git status --porcelain` empty after.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Wiring the four directories instead.** Not done, by ruling: what the config loads stays as it is. Reports, agents, translations and hooks each have their own stack key, but whether a starter should wire them is a product choice for its own card; this report names none.
- **Existing projects.** An already-scaffolded project keeps its `AGENTS.md`. The changeset says how to adopt the fix by hand.

## Verification

<details><summary>Package tests and typecheck</summary>

All readings at head `499412ef` (base `ee7518f9`), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `pnpm --filter 'create-objectstack...' build`.

- `pnpm --filter create-objectstack test`: 20 files, 304 tests passed (the new file included). Lock verdict `command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter create-objectstack typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`): exit 0; `--listFiles` counts the new test file once, so the typecheck covers it.
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/create-objectstack`: exit 0.
- Not done: a scaffold-and-validate run from the local package (the order called it welcome, not required).

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `499412ef`: 59 commands. The lane was wound down mid-run (the maintainer's call to wrap up), so the record is partial: 55 ran, 4 NOT MEASURED because the run was stopped before them (`check:type-check-debt`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, `check:where-matcher`). CI runs all four.
- Of the 55: 53 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (needs a full repo build), NOT MEASURED, left to CI. `check:lean-entry-closure` exit 3 in the loop (objectql `dist` missing); after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/objectql...' build` it answered exit 0 ("Admitted set held exactly (15 packages)").
- Not run locally, as the os-dev scope says: `test:repo`, the repo-wide lint, and the families outside the derivation. The PR's CI check-runs carry them.
- No dogfood battery: the title has no `!`, and `Clause-②` has no `(narrowing)` arm.

</details>
